name: self-improver
description: Revises this repository's improvement policy from measured evidence and proposes the result as pull requests.

roles.verifier: Codex via .github/workflows/codex-review.yml (independent review of every PR, executes tests in its sandbox)
roles.meta_improver: scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py (rewrites the policy from measured validity)
roles.human: merges every pull request; runs the deploy

policy.note: version, topics and threshold live in the policy file itself; read them there
